season.evidence: Only 14 logged ascents: Jul 1, Aug 10, Sep 3. NPS and encyclopedia sources give July-September as the Bailey Range window; NPS says the Elwha Snow Finger and Snow Hump need traction and the Elwha crossing can be impassable. Stored Jul-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 11 Aug track starts at the Queets Basin camp, 24 km from our Sol Duc pin; camp-based, also notes a Barnes SE side trip.
1 Sep long one-way traverse from Sol Duc ending 44 km away at another trailhead; neither a round trip nor trailhead-to-summit one-way.

notes: Both harvested tracks are Bailey Range through-trips or camp-based; the report text of both is too thin to extract route facts.
